meta.title: Find the vibe for tonight · SAHRA
meta.description: See which Cairo restaurants and lounges have a table free tonight and book it from the app. SAHRA is in Arabic and English.

hero.headline: Find the vibe for tonight
hero.supporting: See who's actually free tonight, anywhere in Cairo, and book it. No deposit.

diners.title: Somewhere good tonight, without the phone calls
diners.line: Tell us what you're after and we'll show you one place that's free tonight. Booking takes a minute, that's it.

restaurants.title: Run tonight's book from one screen
restaurants.line: One screen shows you who's actually sitting down tonight and who isn't. You never touch the phone.

how.title: Three taps from "where?" to a table
how.lead: From opening the app to a confirmed table: a minute, not more.

step1.title: Tell us the mood
step1.body: Tell us the mood, where, and how many of you. We'll suggest one place, not a list of forty.

screen.title: What are you in the mood for?

step2.title: See what's really free
step2.body: The times you see come straight from the restaurant's own book. If it says 9:00 is open, it's really open.

step3.title: Just show up
step3.body: No deposit, and nobody calls to confirm. Your booking lives in the app, with directions and a reminder before you go.

features.title: What you get
features.lead: Everything here is already live in the app.

f1.title: English and Arabic
f1.body: The whole app works in both. Switch any time.

f2.title: Real availability
f2.body: What you see is the restaurant's real book, not a request that might get ignored.

f3.title: Book without a deposit
f3.body: Hold a table with your phone number. Nothing gets charged.

f4.title: Saved places
f4.body: Keep a list of the places you keep meaning to try, sorted by neighbourhood.

f5.title: Booking history
f5.body: Every past night in one place, so you remember what was good.

where.title: Cairo first, one neighbourhood at a time
where.lead: We open where the tables are, one area after another. Five districts so far.
where.mapLabel: A map of Cairo showing the neighbourhoods SAHRA covers

operator.title: Fill the room on a Tuesday, keep it calm on a Friday
operator.lead: Tonight's bookings, your floor and your guests' notes, on one screen. We're building it with restaurant teams in Cairo now, and launching with the first ones who join.

faq.title: Questions people ask before their first booking

q1.q: Do I pay anything to book?
q1.a: No. Your phone number is all it takes to hold a table. The only thing with a price is a ticketed event, and you see that before you confirm.

q2.a: Yes. What you see is what the restaurant has open right now, straight from their book. If 9:00 PM shows as free, it's free.

q3.q: Can I use it in Arabic?
q3.a: Yes, all of it. Every screen is in Arabic too, laid out right to left, and you can switch whenever you want.

q4.q: Which parts of Cairo are covered?
q4.a: Right now, Zamalek, Maadi, Heliopolis, New Cairo and Sheikh Zayed. More neighbourhoods open as places sign up.

q5.q: I run a restaurant. How do I join?
q5.a: Tap "Partner with SAHRA" and we'll set your book up together. The restaurant side launches with our first partners.

close.title: Your table's waiting
close.lead: Free on iPhone and Android. English and Arabic.
